user.title: Inverter Analytics
user.description: Pick the inverter to analyse. Sensors are grouped by the integration that created them.

confirm.title: Confirm the detected sensors
confirm.description: Check the mapping and fill in what could not be detected. {no_statistics}

data_description.ct_choice: Which current transformers face the grid. This depends on how they were installed.
data_description.name: Shown in the sidebar page when you have more than one inverter.
data_description.rated_power: The inverter's continuous rated power in watts, from its nameplate. Load bands and overload episodes are measured against it. For a SUN-12K this is 12000.
data_description.rated_power_per_phase: Optional. The per-phase limit in watts. Leave empty to assume a third of the rated power — the analytics will say when it has assumed.
data_description.battery_capacity: Usable capacity in kWh. Used to count equivalent full cycles.
data_description.load_power: Total consumption on the inverter's output. If you also have per-phase sensors, map them below to get imbalance analysis.
data_description.load_power_phase: One sensor per phase, in order L1, L2, L3. Only used for the per-phase section; the totals above stay the source for headline figures.
data_description.pv_power: Total solar production in watts, as the inverter reports it. If you also have per-string sensors, map them below; the total stays the source for headline figures.
data_description.pv_power_string: One sensor per string. Stored now; per-string charts arrive with the solar tab.
data_description.battery_power: Charge and discharge power on one sensor. Use the inversion switch below if the sign runs the other way.
data_description.grid_power: Exchange with the grid. Positive usually means import.
data_description.grid_power_phase: One sensor per phase, in order L1, L2, L3. Positive usually means import — use the inversion switch below if yours runs the other way.
data_description.battery_soc: State of charge in percent. This drives the dip analysis — how often and how deeply the battery is drawn down.
data_description.grid_connected: A binary sensor that is on while grid power is present. Used to measure outages.
data_description.pv_energy_total: A lifetime kWh counter, not a daily one. Daily counters reset and would be read as a drop to zero.
data_description.load_energy_total: A lifetime kWh counter for consumption.
data_description.battery_charge_total: A lifetime kWh counter for energy into the battery.
data_description.battery_discharge_total: A lifetime kWh counter for energy out of the battery.
data_description.grid_import_total: A lifetime kWh counter for energy bought.
data_description.grid_export_total: A lifetime kWh counter for energy sold.
data_description.invert_battery_power: Enable if your sensor reports discharge as a positive number. Easy to check: look at the sign while the battery is charging.
data_description.invert_grid_power: Enable if your sensor reports import as a negative number.
data_description.invert_grid_power_phase: Same, for the per-phase grid sensors.

manual.title: Map sensors manually
manual.description: Only load power and rated power are required. Everything else is optional and feeds analytics that may not be built yet.

data_description.imbalance_floor_pct: Imbalance is only measured while total load is above this share of rated power. At 20 W of night-time load a 5 W spread between phases is a 25% imbalance — true, and meaningless. Default 5%.
data_description.imbalance_threshold_pct: The spread between phases counted as a problem, as a share of their average. Time above it is reported, and runs above it become episodes. Default 30%.
data_description.battery_low_pct: The state of charge counted as low. Time below it is reported, and runs below it become dip episodes. What counts as low differs by chemistry — a lithium pack and a lead-acid one are not comparable here. Default 20%.
data_description.battery_idle_w: Battery power below this, in either direction, is treated as resting rather than charging or discharging. Without it a pack drawing a few watts of standby would be reported as working all night. Default 50 W.
